clue.text: This compiler's rank keeping style excessive

indicators.note: keeping means holding something within, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: the setter speaking of themself: I am, shortened to I'M
rank as a verb means rate or grade
a style or manner is a mode

explanation.surface: A setter boasts that their standing keeps their style over the top.
explanation.walkthrough: 'This compiler's' is the setter referring to themself, so it means I am, shortened; the style is then held between its two parts.
explanation.definitionFit: Immoderate means going beyond reasonable limits, a synonym of excessive.

clue.text: Occasionally indulged unemployed

indicators.note: occasionally means only now and then, so take every other letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Someone out of work treats themself now and then.
explanation.definitionFit: Idle describes a person or machine not working, without a job or task.

clue.text: Unrivalled learner in dull board game

parts.note: mat (or matt) describes a dull, non-shiny finish

indicators.note: in puts the learner inside the board game

parts.note: chess is a board game
L, as on a learner driver's L-plate

explanation.surface: A beginner is unbeatable at a dull board game.
explanation.walkthrough: MAT is the dull finish, then L goes into CHESS to make CHLESS.
explanation.definitionFit: Matchless means having no equal, the same as unrivalled.

clue.text: Sad deranged idiot, snapping

indicators.note: deranged means disordered, so the letters of both following words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A miserable, unhinged fool loses their temper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deranged' rearranges all the letters of IDIOT and SNAPPING together.
explanation.definitionFit: Something disappointing leaves you sad or let down; here the definition is the feeling it causes.

clue.text: Swimming round catching fish

indicators.note: catching means holding, so the round goes around the fish

parts.note: a ring is round in shape
an eel is a fish

explanation.surface: An angler's line goes round, hooking a fish in the water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swimming' is not about water here: it is the dizzy, head-spinning sense.
explanation.definitionFit: When your head is swimming you feel giddy and dazed, which is reeling.

clue.text: Outfit conquers sweetheart in double time

indicators.note: in puts the winner and the heart inside the two times
double means twice over, so the time letter is written two times

parts.note: wins means conquers, beats
the heart of sweet is its middle letter E

explanation.surface: A dancer's costume triumphs as the sweetheart goes into double time.
explanation.walkthrough: A twinset is a matching cardigan and jumper (sweater) worn together, a classic British outfit.
explanation.definitionFit: A twinset is a set of matching garments worn together, so it is an outfit.

clue.text: Dairy product from European cow, say

parts.note: a cow is an example of a dam, the mother of an animal

explanation.surface: Milk products come from a cow in Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: Edam is a Dutch cheese, and cheese is made from milk.

clue.text: Dark end of dead end

indicators.note: end of takes only the final letter of the following word

parts.note: the rear is the back end

explanation.surface: A gloomy picture of the far end of a dead end.
explanation.definitionFit: Drear is a poetic form of dreary, meaning gloomy and dark.

clue.text: Stock's quality about right for soup

parts.note: a mine is a rich stock or store of something; with the 's it gives MINES

indicators.note: about means around, so the quality wraps the R

parts.note: tone is a quality of sound or colour

explanation.surface: A cook judges the quality of stock before making soup.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stock' and 'soup' look like the same kitchen, but stock here is a supply, a mine.
explanation.definitionFit: Minestrone is a thick Italian vegetable soup.

clue.text: Luxury car plant

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a British maker of sports cars

explanation.walkthrough: Lotus is a British sports-car maker; the lotus is also an Asian water plant.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a sports-car brand and a flowering aquatic plant.

clue.text: A nice, pure spread supplying gourmet

indicators.note: spread means scattered about, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A lovely, unadulterated paste on toast for a lover of good food.
explanation.definitionFit: An epicurean is a person devoted to fine food and drink, a gourmet.

clue.text: Man on tube line turning indecent

indicators.note: turning means changing, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A commuter on the Underground grows rude.
explanation.definitionFit: Unmentionable things are too shocking or improper to speak of, hence indecent.

clue.text: Pastries following joint for flower children

indicators.note: following means coming after, so the pastries go after the joint

parts.note: the hip is a joint of the body
pies are pastries

explanation.surface: Baked treats after a joint: a 1960s commune's munchies, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'joint' hints at a cannabis cigarette, but it is the body's hip.
explanation.definitionFit: Flower children was a 1960s name for hippies, who wore flowers as a peace symbol.

clue.text: Extra seconds showing manners

parts.note: more means extra

explanation.surface: Asking for second helpings shows good manners.
explanation.definitionFit: Mores are the customs and conventions of a society, its manners.

clue.text: Strangely rum end with free vote

indicators.note: strangely means oddly, so the letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: An odd finish, with free drinks laid on at an election.
explanation.definitionFit: A referendum is a public vote on a single question.

clue.text: Queen energy new in record soon

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina
E is the physics symbol for energy

indicators.note: in puts new inside the record

parts.note: a log is a record

explanation.surface: The Queen sets a new energy record soon.
explanation.definitionFit: Erelong is an old word meaning before long, shortly.

clue.text: Comparatively spicy foreign port

definitions.meaning: first meaning: more tangy, the comparative of tangy

explanation.walkthrough: Tangier is a Moroccan port on the Strait of Gibraltar; tangier is also more tangy.
explanation.definitionFit: One spelling serves as the comparative of tangy and as the name of a North African harbour city.

clue.text: Painter pretending to cover render

indicators.note: the words are made to cover, that is contain, the answer within them

explanation.surface: An artist is faking it to hide what they are depicting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'render' looks like painting talk, but it means translate.
explanation.definitionFit: To render a text in another language is to interpret or translate it.

clue.text: German city Cologne cleared for perfume

parts.note: Essen is a city in Germany

indicators.note: cleared means emptied, so only the outside letters stay

explanation.surface: A German city empties its shelves of eau de Cologne.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cologne' sounds like scent and a German city, but it is only fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: An essence is a concentrated scent, a perfume.

clue.text: More futile English politician leading bank

indicators.note: leading means going in front, so the English politician comes before the bank

parts.note: MP, Member of Parliament
a tier is a bank or row, as of seats

explanation.surface: An English MP in charge of a bank achieves even less.
explanation.definitionFit: Emptier means more lacking in meaning or purpose, more futile.

clue.text: Fluff admitted by criminal American president

indicators.note: admitted by means let inside, so the criminal holds the fluff

parts.note: a con is a convict, a criminal
lint is fluff from fabric

explanation.surface: A crook confesses to a minor slip about a president.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fluff' reads as a blunder admitted, but it is lint.
explanation.definitionFit: Bill Clinton was the 42nd President of the United States.

clue.text: Drop in church saint conversions

indicators.note: in puts the drop inside the church

parts.note: CE, Church of England
to hang is to drop or droop down

explanation.surface: Falling attendance at a church and conversions of saints.
explanation.definitionFit: Changes and conversions are both transformations from one thing into another.

clue.text: Tedium encapsulated by outspoken nuisance

indicators.note: encapsulated by means enclosed within, so the answer is inside the following words

explanation.surface: Boredom brought on by a loudmouthed pest.
explanation.definitionFit: Ennui is a French borrowing for listless boredom.

clue.text: Denial admitting good person is obscene

indicators.note: admitting means letting in, so the denial wraps the good person

parts.note: nay is a refusal, a denial
ST, saint, a good person

explanation.surface: Denying it, though letting the good person in, is offensive.
explanation.definitionFit: Nasty can mean offensive or indecent, as in nasty language.

clue.text: Organiser oddly paler welcoming Queen

indicators.note: welcoming means taking in, so the queen goes inside
oddly takes the odd-numbered letters of the next word

parts.note: Anne was Queen of Great Britain

explanation.surface: An event organiser goes rather pale as the Queen arrives.
explanation.walkthrough: The Queen is Queen Anne, who reigned 1702 to 1714.
explanation.definitionFit: A planner is someone who organises things in advance.

clue.text: Feel extreme anxiety rising, initially

indicators.note: initially means at the start, so take the first letter of each word

explanation.surface: Panic swells at the start.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue does both jobs: its first letters spell the word, and it describes what that word is.
explanation.definitionFit: Fear is the extreme anxiety that rises in us when threatened.

clue.text: Condescending, possessing small cunning

indicators.note: possessing means having within, so the condescending word holds small

parts.note: deigning means condescending to do something

explanation.surface: A haughty schemer with little craft.
explanation.definitionFit: A designing person is scheming and crafty.

clue.text: Good in nude displaying craft

indicators.note: in here means placed within, so the letter for Good is set inside the word for nude

parts.note: bare means nude

explanation.surface: Someone shows off their skill while naked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'craft' looks like skill but it is a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A barge is a flat-bottomed boat, a kind of craft or vessel.

clue.text: Can, perhaps, with old sauce

parts.note: may and can both express permission, so can is an example

explanation.surface: An old tin of sauce, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Can' looks like a tin, but it is the verb of permission.
explanation.definitionFit: Mayo is short for mayonnaise, an egg-and-oil dressing.

clue.text: Sort copper out? One possibly does

indicators.note: out means put wrong, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone asks who sifts copper from ore, then answers it.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition refers back: a mining hopeful is someone who might sort copper out.
explanation.definitionFit: A prospector searches the ground for metal ores such as copper.
